what: A fix moved a blocking call into asynchronous code and kept calling it exactly the same way as before. Every existing test passed, because none of them ever ran anything else at the same time; only once the change reached a real concurrent caller did the now-genuine wait visibly stall everything sharing that same thread.
rule: A change that moves blocking work into or out of asynchronous code must say where that work now actually runs (a background thread versus the main event loop) and needs one test proving a second, unrelated task keeps making progress while it is in flight.
fix: Enforcement: the shared contract template's own test-plan section now asks for exactly that. Template change only; no code check.
